channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Body position channel (DC transducer).

channels.label: DX1
channels.reason: Italian 'dx' means right; EMG transducer, so this is the right leg EMG electrode referenced to DX2.

channels.label: DX2
channels.reason: Second right leg electrode, used as the reference for DX1.

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone with Sound transducer, so this is the snore sensor.

channels.label: C3
channels.reason: Unreferenced C3 electrode; contralateral mastoid A2 is recorded separately.

channels.label: C4
channels.reason: Unreferenced C4 electrode; contralateral mastoid A1 is recorded separately.

channels.label: ECG1
channels.reason: ECG electrode 1, referenced to ECG2 to form the ECG lead.

channels.label: ECG2
channels.reason: Second ECG electrode, used as the reference for ECG1.

channels.label: A1
channels.reason: Left mastoid reference electrode.

channels.label: A2
channels.reason: Right mastoid reference electrode.

channels.label: ROC
channels.reason: Right EOG channel by label and EOG transducer.
